label: R18-CORE-SYSKILL-CUT
scope: 在保持精确异常/IRQ/restore kill、held response、单在途 owner、FCVT GPR RAW 和提交顺序的前提下，切断 sys_commit 到 fp_tx_kill/TX_DONE 的冗余组合反馈，并加入 owner 互斥的 SVA、SV 和 Cocotb 定向覆盖。

timing_input.cause: decode/live forwarding -> sys_commit_ready/sys_commit -> fp_tx_kill -> fp_rsp_ready/rsp_ready -> TX_DONE D

implementation.summary: fp_tx_kill retains fetch_merge_wb, wb_exc_commit, irq_taken, wfi_irq_take, wfi_wake and difftest_restore_sys_valid, while sys_commit is removed. fp_tx_active aggregates candidate/issued/busy/response phases for five same-cycle mutual-exclusion assertions. The existing core SV smoke gains +T016_SYSKILL probes for TX_DONE hold, MSR/ERET/UDEF/WFI and FCVTZS/FCVTZU raw GPR-to-CBNZ paths; a standalone Cocotb module mirrors these checks.

proof.sys_commit_drain: sys_commit requires !idex_valid && !exmem_valid && !memwb_valid plus sys_commit_ready and commit_ready

runs.command: static source check of fp_tx_kill real-kill closure, sys_commit exclusion, SVA and focused test markers

not_run: Verilator compile, SV runtime and Cocotb runtime
QEMU build, plugin, reference results and strict lockstep
Quartus synthesis/fitter/signoff STA and new top-50
assembler, SOF/bitstream, JTAG, programming, power-on and board test
known_limits: Owner evidence proves only source structure and lightweight syntax; no functional green result is claimed until the integrator runs the focused and joint regressions on the merged SHA.
Physical improvement is not claimed until a fresh post-fit STA confirms the idex_valid-to-TX_DONE cone is removed or reports its replacement cone.
The SV +T016_SYSKILL path reuses the existing core smoke harness and is not executed by the owner per the task resource gate.
integrator_fields_pending: merged candidate SHA and source/artifact hashes
focused SV/Cocotb result plus complete affected L0-L2 union, including T-012 overlap, IRQ-young and P7 regressions
new physical synthesis/fitter/signoff STA, directional old/new cone counts, top-N cluster and timing/resource delta
board_policy: No assembler, bitstream, JTAG, programming, power-on or board test without explicit user permission.
